claims.claim: Static exact-partner classifications in the report’s declared cubic, homogeneous quartic, qF(p) and monomial scopes.
claims.scope: Retained proofs and scoped replay; no blanket novelty claim.

claims.claim: Iterated correction left ideals stabilize in the Weyl algebra; a finite right-D-stable presentation with both containments defines the full polynomial dynamic core.
claims.scope: Characteristic-zero exact operator identities; finite PDE presentation, not a completed solution classification.

claims.claim: For H=qp^3+lambda q^2, the dynamic core is Q[p]+qQ[p] at lambda=0 and span{1,H} for nonzero rational lambda.
claims.scope: Derived by algebraic scalar extension, affine-symplectic scaling and descent from retained cases; no priority claim.

claims.claim: Minimal rational target-word observer with provenance, intertwining and sensor factorization or hidden-state witness.
claims.scope: Finite known rational actions; all future words; linear state summaries; no general noisy/adaptive optimizer.

claims.claim: Exact normally ordered Weyl arithmetic and independent three-identity receipt replay.
claims.scope: Rational coefficients; replay checker for receipts produced by extensions/hamiltonian/weyl_groebner.py (W1).

claims.claim: Construct and independently check finite Q-complex contractions; return a primitive or separating obstruction witness.
claims.support: extensions/structure/obstruction.py (S1 answers) over the seed contraction
claims.scope: Finite rational complexes; no integral torsion or arbitrary DGLA/sheaf input adapter shipped.

claims.claim: Remaining open targets: probabilistic or continuous noise models for adaptive experiments; dynamic cores of homogeneous Hamiltonians of degree >= 7 and of inhomogeneous quintic/sextic families.
claims.scope: Unfinished tasks, not current capabilities.

claims.claim: Typed machinery-envelope-v1 objects bind certificates to model/payload hashes, domain Q, hypotheses, scope and atlas source ids, and dispatch to independent checkers; swapped witness kinds and unknown domains are rejected.
claims.scope: Registry of fifteen witness kinds; domains Q and Z.

claims.claim: Fixed-H left Groebner closure of the iterated correction ideal exporting replayable correction-containment, provenance and right-D closure receipts; budget exhaustion returns unknown.
claims.scope: One canonical pair over Q; termination is guaranteed by Noetherianity, not by a complexity bound; q^4+p^4 exceeds the default budget.

claims.claim: Support certificates (monomial span, finite support, weighted degree bound) determine the polynomial common kernel of a receipt ideal in all degrees.
claims.scope: Applies when the stated monomial-action / top-symbol hypotheses hold; otherwise the producer reports unclassified.

claims.claim: All-degree dynamic cores: q^3 -> Q[q]+pQ[q]+p^2Q[q]; qp^3 and qp^3+p^2 -> Q[p]+qQ[p]; qp^3+q^2, qp^3+q^2+p^2, p^3+q^2 -> span{1,H}; q^3p^3 and q^2p^2 -> Q[qp]; q^2p^3 -> span{1,qp,q^2p^3}; I_inf(qp^3) is strictly inside W2 dq^2 and I_inf(q^3p^3) = W2(q dq - p dp).
claims.scope: Exact certificates over Q; q^3, qp^3, qp^3+q^2 are calibrations of retained or derived results; no literature-priority claim.

claims.claim: For all rational alpha, beta: D_inf(qp^3+alpha q^2+beta p^2) = Q[p]+qQ[p] if alpha=0 and span{1,H} if alpha!=0; the static partner space is constant on the whole family.
claims.scope: Two-parameter family; GL2 covariance of transvectants, normal forms over Qbar and descent; the six-parameter family remains open. Reproduces N002 as beta=0.

claims.claim: Exact minimum-cost static sensor panel under a declared ellipsoidal (correlated) noise matrix and amplification cap, with PSD/negative-witness branch-and-bound certificates and incomplete-with-bound outputs; invariant-metric certificates for all-time bounds (sufficient only).
claims.scope: Finite menus, deterministic noise sets, initial static panels, tie policy one_optimum; worst-case search is exponential.

claims.claim: Exact worst-case optimal adaptive decision trees for deterministic finite test tables with Bellman lower-bound tables, or an unresolvable pair.
claims.scope: At most 12 states; deterministic outcomes only.

claims.claim: Order-by-order Maurer-Cartan lifting in finite DGLAs over Q via the contraction, with explicit corrections or obstruction functionals; Chevalley-Eilenberg/Nijenhuis-Richardson generator for Lie deformations; order-2 obstructions are intrinsic to the first-order class.
claims.scope: Formal truncated lifting; higher-order witnesses are relative to the declared jet; no convergence or moduli claim.

claims.claim: Complete supplied-unit orbit classification for x^2-Dy^2=N with exact modular cycles and filtered height counts.
claims.scope: Declared order Z[sqrt D], supplied (possibly nonfundamental) unit; completeness rests on the reduction proof in OBSTRUCTIONS_AND_ARITHMETIC.md.

claims.claim: For all rational a,b,c,d,e,f: D_inf(qp^3+aq^2+bqp+cp^2+dq+ep+f) = Q[p]+qQ[p] if a=0 and span{1,H} if a!=0. Proved by the top-weight reduction lemma (weight (3,1)), which embeds gr D_inf(H) into D_inf(H_w).
claims.scope: One canonical pair over Q; the lemma itself applies to any polynomial H and positive weight; instance certificates replay the lemma hypotheses exactly.

claims.claim: Integral cohomology of finite integer cochain complexes via certified Smith forms, with integer primitives or rational / mod-m torsion obstruction functionals.
claims.scope: Finite complexes over Z; size budget returns unknown.

claims.claim: Certified fundamental units of Z[sqrt D] (Legendre convergent criterion) and of Z[(1+sqrt D)/2] for D = 1 mod 4 (index-3 cube-root argument); Pell orbits under the full norm-one unit group of either order.
claims.scope: Real quadratic orders Z[sqrt D] and Z[(1+sqrt D)/2]; maximality of the latter needs D squarefree.

claims.claim: Rational invariant-metric search (finite-semigroup averages, truncated weighted word sums) with exact acceptance; failure reported as no_certificate.
claims.scope: Sufficient certificates only; no SDP solver.

claims.claim: Homogeneous quartics of root types (4), (3,1), (2,2), (2,1,1) over Q: D_inf = (+)_{j<=2} M^j Q[L], Q[L] + M Q[L], Q[Q], span{1,H} respectively.
claims.scope: Each type is a single GL2(Qbar) class; transport and descent via GL2 covariance of the transvectants.

claims.claim: For every binary quartic H over Qbar with distinct roots and every certified degree n: D_inf(H)_n = 0 for n not in {0,4} and D_inf(H)_4 = Qbar H; the only exceptional factor of the family q^4 + l q^2 p^2 + p^4 is l^2 - 4.
claims.scope: Finitely many degrees (see the certificate); depth R <= 3; not a uniform-in-degree theorem.

claims.claim: D_inf(q^4+p^4) = span{1,H} and D_inf(q^4+q^2p^2+p^4) = span{1,H} in all degrees.
claims.scope: Exact all-degree certificates over Q.

claims.claim: D_inf(H) = span{1,H} in all degrees for every binary quartic with distinct roots (over Q or any field of characteristic zero).
claims.scope: All degrees; parity splitting, top-coefficient elimination with resultants in l valid for n >= 8, per-degree certificate for n <= 12. With W3-a this classifies every homogeneous quartic.

claims.claim: Monomial root classes of quintics and sextics: D_inf(q^5) and D_inf(q^6) = (+)_{j<=2} p^j Q[q]; D_inf(q^4 p) and D_inf(q^5 p) = Q[q] + pQ[q]; D_inf(q^4 p^2) = span{1, qp, q^4 p^2} (with q^2 p^3 and q^3 p^3 already certified).
claims.scope: All polynomial degrees; monomial-span support certificates over Q.

claims.claim: Static finiteness at a simple root: for a binary form H of degree d in {5,6} with a simple root, E_n(H) = {G : T_3(H,G) = T_5(H,G) = 0} vanishes for all n >= N0 (N0 = 10 for d = 5, 17 for d = 6) unless H has type (d-1,1) or (d-2,1,1).
claims.scope: Characteristic zero, algebraically closed; local normal form, static top lemma, re-derived top equations, elimination trees of explicit polynomial identities over Q[n] (searched with sympy, replayed with exact arithmetic).

claims.claim: Classification of D_inf(H) for every nonzero binary quintic or sextic over a field of characteristic zero: (+)_{j<=2} m^j K[l] for c l^d; K[l] + mK[l] for c l^(d-1) m; span{1, lm, H} for c l^(d-2) m^2; K[Q] for sextics c Q^3; span{1, H} for every form with at least three distinct roots.
claims.support: programmes/DYNAMIC_CORE_RESULTS.md#3d; W4-a, W4-b; top-weight lemma (W2); centralizer and sl2 lemmas
claims.scope: All degrees; routes A (monomial classes), B (root of multiplicity 2 or d-2 with the top-weight lemma), C (types (1^5), (1^6), (3,1,1,1): static finiteness and a chain argument). With W3 this covers every binary form of degree <= 6. No novelty claim.

rule: Passing finite tests does not upgrade a target or an unproved general statement to a theorem.
